findings.summary: THE ZERO-DELTA GUARD FIRED AS DESIGNED — first honest failure of the Runtime repair chain: after REVISE→REVISE→BLOCKED false-successes over the byte-identical af164b9 (runs 32864270667/32875577618/32877702179), repair round 3 again delivered zero edits, but this time the 751496a launcher refused to call it success: 'SPIDER_ZERO_DELTA_REPAIR: OpenCode reported success but produced no durable repair delta' → exit 67 → conclusion=failure, auditor/director skipped instead of an auditor having to burn ~16 min discovering tip==base. The substantive RF1–RF6 work was NOT done in this round (see other findings); the productive continuation had already been launched in parallel as the fresh-work cycle run 32887030457 (created 18:59:53Z, while r3 was still running — observed ~19 min overlap of two runtime-loop runs). Residual imperfection: the persist step still force-pushed unchanged af164b9 under a FOURTH run-id branch name (cycle/runtime/32885208777/team) before the job failed — provenance noise continues even when the guard fires; only the conclusion became honest.

CONTEXT-AMNESIAC RETRY ECONOMICS quantified (~37m21s runner wall, zero output bytes): every retry restarts OpenCode with fresh context, so each of the 3 attempts re-performed the full exploration (role card → master prompt/V2 → audit gate JSON + report → directive/prereg → resolver/loop/adapters/accounting/bench/tests) before dying. Dead time: 2×300s backoffs = 10m; duplicated exploration across attempts ≈ 20m+. No checkpoint/resume exists between attempts.

research_opportunities: Retry redesign for agent sessions (now evidenced in TWO lanes): (a) exempt or extend the 300s stall window while subagents are active (the launcher knows when delegation is in flight), or require periodic heartbeat output from the parent session during subagent waves; (b) checkpoint per-attempt state (a short progress file written under /tmp and re-fed into the next attempt's prompt would have saved ~20m of duplicated exploration here); (c) consider resuming the same OpenCode session instead of respawning.

Complete the zero-delta guard: additionally SKIP the branch push (not just fail the job) when tip==base and diff==empty, eliminating the fourth duplicate af164b9 branch namespace; alternatively tag such pushes 'duplicate-of-base' for provenance tooling.

Pre-install the test stack (pytest, playwright + `playwright install chromium`) in lane loop workflows before the agent phase — removes a recurring discovery tax AND removes the incentive for agents to probe outside-workspace caches (permission-kill family trigger surface shrinks).

Repair-vs-fresh-cycle policy is now empirically settled for this chain (three repair rounds ≈ 66+37 min for zero deltas vs a fresh cycle delivering real artifacts in parallel): encode 'after one failed repair round, default to fresh-cycle-carrying-the-RF-list' in lane orchestration; verify whether RF1–RF6 items were superseded or remain open against the fresh lineage (runs 32887030457 → 32908002333 integration) before treating them as current debt.
